title: Spread Methods for Induced Cycles
summary: We develop a spread-based approach to finding induced cycles and apply it to two problems. First, we resolve the odd-hole gadget conjecture of Bradač, Draganić and Sudakov by constructing an $e^{O(k)}$-edge graph whose every $k$-edge-colouring contains a monochromatic induced odd cycle of length $O(\log k)$. As a consequence, for every $k\ge2$ and every sufficiently large odd $n$, $$ \widehat R_{\mathrm{ind}}(C_n;k)=e^{Θ(k)}n. $$ The proof uses spread probability weights together with hypergraph containers.
